<div class="card-body">
'''Jek Porkins''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジェック・ポーキンズ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド６を操縦していれば、さらに回避値が＋１され、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に１枚だけ引ける。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド６を操縦する。掃射攻撃を得意とする。ティアフォン反乱軍前哨基地で、イエローエース中隊に属していた。元はベスティン星系の独立貿易商人。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jek Porkins.

'''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Red 6, its maneuver is increased by 1 and he may draw one battle destiny if unable to draw one.

'''Lore:''' Piloted Red 6 in the Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing attacks. Served in the Yellow Aces squadron at the Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Formerly an independent trader from the Bestine system.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says he was formerly an independent trader. The English says he is a free trader from the Bestine system. The game text expresses the same listed bonuses in different wording.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Jek Porkins]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97.
